spans.s:
f. (-दुत् or दुद्)
Anxiety, uneasiness.
E.
दु to give pain, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-द्दः-द्दा-द्दं)
1 Giving pain.
2 Wicked.
E.
दुद्, and द who or what gives.

mfn. (दः-दा-दं)
Afflicting, harassing.
E.
दू, and द what gives or occasions.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to play with or brandish.
E.
दिव to play, desid. form irr., उ aff.

m. (-मः)
A green onion.
E.
दु bad, द्रुम tree; onions being prohibited food.
